**Finding: compliant (no redline proposed).**

M&I has no audit, inspection or verification right against Customer anywhere in the Agreement. I searched audit/inspection/verification/records/access/underpayment terms across all sections; the only audit-type provisions run in our favour:

- **§ 21.8(C) (p0277)** — M&I must procure an annual independent third-party review of *its own* data processing centre and internal controls, give us a free copy of the report, and implement the recommendations.
- **§ 21.8(B) (p0276)** and **§ 17.1 (p0243)** — preserve our regulators'/auditors' access to records M&I holds for us.

Because no audit right binds Customer, there is no frequency, notice, cost-allocation or system-access exposure to cap, and adding the preferred parameters would only manufacture a vendor right that does not currently exist.

Noted in the rationale rather than flagged (not AUDIT deviations):
- **§ 21.8 (p0274)** — we reimburse M&I's reasonable costs of a regulatory examination performed solely to examine Services used by us.
- **§ 21.7(C)(ii) (p0273)** — we must provide evidence on request that the Agreement is properly reflected on our books and records; a representation-support obligation with no inspection or system-access component.
